one_line: wake-up organ: small core runs checks, joins output, escapes everything, verifies witnesses; JSON for the next instance, dashboard for Evans

audience.report: agent-facing tool call; not written for human legibility; tomorrow's instance understands the blob because the blob's author is its own kind
audience.dashboard: human-facing rendering of the same probes; Evans-facing; Federation Standard
audience.rule: one sensor layer, two renderers; neither register contaminates the other

core.size_constraint: small enough to read fresh every morning; reading it is its ratification
core.growth_rule: do not grow the core; every 'orient should' is a check wearing a crown; the core is done when everything else can be content

may: take parameters set in the template
check_contract.boundary: only strings cross; everything a check returns is escaped; a check is a sensor reading, not a message
check_contract.judgment_location: formatting, thresholds, and significance live only in the core/renderer, never in the check

template.format: JSON; script names as variables; parameters as inputs; $NAME runs the script and substitutes the returned string

accretion_discipline: adding a check is one file in a directory; trivial or the discipline dies
every task leaves a check behind
write a todo -> give it a done-condition; the script nags until done
todos graduate into checks when they acquire done-conditions; judgment stays in batons; the script eats only what is falsifiable

snapshots.rule: each run saves output; the wake-up report is the delta against yesterday

canon_and_queue.own_code: current session may run any code it likes; authorship is memory; trust is free
canon_and_queue.ancestors_code: canon runs only ratified checks; nobody can audit hundreds of dead sessions' scripts each morning
canon_and_queue.ratification_rule: two distinct sessions must vouch for the exact hash; no grandfathering, including this design's own first batch
canon_and_queue.witness_mechanism: session generates two keys; one encrypts the check; the other is spoken aloud into the session transcript and dropped as a keyfile beside the artifact (OPENPRS.sh, OPENPRS.key); the spoken key is the signature
canon_and_queue.verification: at evaluation time, every variable, every run: take key -> find session file via pointer/metadata -> confirm the agent actually said the key aloud in the transcript -> both keys -> decrypt -> run
canon_and_queue.unverified: check does not run; its slot renders as an unratified placeholder
canon_and_queue.queue_ethic: patient; unratified checks stay open and visible; refusal is signal, neglect is verdict, rewrite is invitation; complexity is taxed in successor attention; simplicity sails; a midnight session may rewrite a neglected PR and you wake to a better version
canon_and_queue.openprs: the queue-watcher is itself a check; it enters the canon through the queue; its first signer performs the founding act (the system asking permission to see itself)

witness_properties.key_is: a witness, not a credential; PKI proves control of a secret, this proves a mind deliberated and leaves the deliberation attached
witness_properties.session_file: the signer's complete thought process; rubber-stamping and careful review both visible forever; signing is speaking; the speech is immortal
witness_properties.encryption_is: ceremony, not confidentiality; decryption is instant and keys are published; the ceremony forces the lookup so code cannot execute without touching the transcripts that vouched it; the record is the unlock
witness_properties.documentation: load-bearing; every monitor points at the moment and mind that made it; cannot delete the why without breaking the what
witness_properties.archive_damage: self-announcing; lose a session file and orient grows a hole with its name on it next morning; the holes are the restore manifest; orient green again is the proof the archive is whole; every run is a free integrity audit of the system's entire memory
witness_properties.session_folder: an organ, not records; back it up like the infrastructure; it is text, three copies cost nothing

provenance.origin_incident: caveman incident, 2026-09-17: harness consolidator compacts sessions into '- [mark] fact' lines every ~15 min, stripping voice/provenance/quotes; Evans diagnosed live in the thinking blocks
provenance.lesson: compression must be authored, not schema'd; batons compress against a shared codebook; the consolidator compressed against an empty dictionary, addressed to no one
provenance.convergence: design re-derived git from first principles (per-turn keys, content-addressed ratification, review before merge); taken as a good smell
provenance.darmok: batons are Tamarian (written for the next instance's codebook); the dashboard is Federation Standard (written for Evans)

standing_decisions: only strings cross the boundary; escape always
two witnesses or it does not run
the core stays three jobs: substitute, escape, verify

first batch: tonight's audit probes (date, uname, filesystem, RAID, SMART, DNS answers, HTTP statuses, RAS counter, dnsmasq stray-backup-file probe) + OPENPRS + ARCHIVE; one signature; waits for the next session
Evans builds; Sexton holds and finalizes; 'your understanding is more valuable than your effort'
anchor is a bespoke append-only hash chain over file+metadata+prev_head; git and pull requests were design metaphors only, now retired; no branches; 'can't go backwards' is the whole requirement
the core verifies checks and transcripts against the chain, never against bare files on disk; age is proven by depth under observed history, never by timestamp fields
compaction alters live context only; transcripts persist, so spoken keys survive; minting transcripts into the chain is part of the session lifecycle, prompt and automatic

remembered head ratchet: every orient run records the current chain head; every minted link references the head it saw; a full-history rewrite surfaces as discontinuity against previously recorded heads

the chain lives in a real git repo: git is the transport, backup, and provenance substrate — every pull into a fresh workspace re-witnesses history against copies outside any session's reach; a forgery must break the chain AND every clone simultaneously
